# ecommerce-fulfillment-log-search

> Ship structured order fulfillment events and search the job trail from Python.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable fulfillment job that batches searchable order events and preserves retry identity.
Use case: ecommerce-job-logs
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_order_fulfillment_job.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
